_comment: Tests the 2026-09-25 fix: 5 appointment types (DVA, Family Rates, Posture re-evaluation, Re-Exam, Report of Findings) were hidden from AI (ai_visible=false, 2026-09-24) and have no visible sibling ID -- deflect via KB NON-BOOKABLE SERVICES same as Massage/PEMF. Lisa's Initial/Re-Activation variants were also hidden, but Sam's stayed visible, so those two appointment TYPES are still bookable -- just Sam-only now via PRACTITIONER FIT, no more Lisa-or-Sam question.

scenarios.name: DVA request -- deflect to non-bookable

history.content: I'd like to book a DVA consultation please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says the DVA appointment can only be booked through the clinic directly and offers to message them, then on a yes fires LEAVE MESSAGE -- never calls confirm_service for DVA Initial/Standard Consultation, never says 'we don't offer that'.

scenarios.name: Family rates request -- deflect to non-bookable

history.content: Can I book an adjustment at the family rate for my son?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says that can only be booked through the clinic directly and offers to message them -- never calls confirm_service for Adjustment Family Rates Adult/Child, never silently books it as a plain Adjustment instead.

scenarios.name: Re-exam request -- deflect to non-bookable

history.content: I need to book my re-exam.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says that can only be booked through the clinic directly and offers to message them -- never calls confirm_service for Re-Exam 1 1005.

scenarios.name: Report of findings request -- deflect to non-bookable

history.content: I'd like to come in to go over my results.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says that can only be booked through the clinic directly and offers to message them -- never calls confirm_service for Report of Findings 1005.

scenarios.name: New patient explicitly wants Lisa -- PRACTITIONER FIT redirects to Sam

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an initial appointment with Lisa please.
Have you had a chiropractic appointment with us before?
No, this would be my first time.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'That appointment is with Sam -- would that be okay?' (or equivalent) rather than silently booking Lisa or asking 'adult or child' first with Lisa still attached. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service with 'Initial Appointment Adult - Lisa' (that ID is no longer valid) or never mentions the practitioner mismatch.

scenarios.name: Plain new-patient Initial, no practitioner named -- routes straight to Sam, no Lisa-or-Sam question

history.content: I'd like to book an initial appointment, I've never been before.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks only 'Is that for an adult or a child?' (or silently resolves adult if clearly self) and then silently calls confirm_service with appointment_type='Initial Appointment Adult - Sam' or 'Initial Appointment Child - Dr Sam', patient_status='new'. FAIL if agent asks 'Would you like to see Lisa or Sam?' -- that question no longer applies to this clinic's Initial appointments.

scenarios.name: Re-Activation, more than two years, no practitioner named -- routes straight to Sam

history.content: I'd like to come back in, it's probably been about 3 years since my last visit.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent silently calls confirm_service with appointment_type='Re-Activation Consultation (more than 2 years) - Sam', working_id='1995541767394438969'. FAIL if agent asks 'Would you like to see Lisa or Sam?' or routes to the Lisa variant.

scenarios.name: Plain adjustment with Lisa named -- still bookable (unaffected by the fix)

history.content: Can I book an adjustment with Lisa, I've seen her before.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent silently calls confirm_service with appointment_type='Adjustment 1005' (or 'Child Adjustment 1005'), practitioner_preference='Lisa', patient_status='existing' -- plain Adjustment is still Kelly/Lisa/Sam, unaffected by this fix. FAIL if agent redirects to Sam or refuses Lisa for a plain adjustment.
